rendered:

To find out how many times faster delamination is at the boiling point, we can divide the time it takes at 160 °C by the time it takes at the boiling point:

6 seconds (at 160 °C) ÷ 2 seconds (at boiling point) = 3 times faster

So, delamination at the boiling point of ethylene glycol is 3 times faster than at 160 °C.
